description:
Subject: Customer Satisfaction Survey  

We are reaching out to gather your feedback through a brief Customer Satisfaction Survey. The first question asks, “How satisfied are you with our product quality?” and provides the following response options: Very satisfied, Somewhat satisfied, Neutral, Somewhat dissatisfied, and Very dissatisfied. The second question is, “How likely are you to recommend our service to a friend?” with options ranging from Very likely, Likely, Neutral, Unlikely, to Very unlikely. Finally, we would like to know, “What is your preferred method of receiving support?” and you can choose from Phone, Email, Live chat, In‑app messaging, or Self‑service portal.  

Your responses will help us improve our offerings and support experience, so we appreciate you taking a few minutes to complete the survey.
